meta.title: ATOMSTAR · IT Consulting and Adversarial Research
meta.description: Atomstar is a Quebec IT consultancy with an offensive security research practice: infrastructure, identity, penetration testing, and AI agent security.
meta.ogTitle: ATOMSTAR — IT Consulting and Adversarial Research
meta.ogDescription: Infrastructure, identity and continuity engineering, plus penetration testing, vulnerability research and AI agent security.

hero.sub: An IT consultancy with a research practice.

cards.title: Infrastructure as code.
cards.body: Production infrastructure defined in a repository. Versioned, reviewable, reproducible.

cards.title: Identity and access.
cards.body: Directory services, access management, device management, and key infrastructure. Documentation included.

cards.title: Network and continuity.
cards.body: Network design, overlay meshes, site-to-site links, backup, and continuity planning.

offensive.title: Offensive Security.
offensive.lede: Independent security review of what you ship and what you depend on.

cards.title: Vulnerability research.
cards.body: Independent research and coordinated disclosure. Six published CVEs since 2019.

cards.title: Penetration testing.
cards.body: Web, network, cloud, and internal engagements. Findings documented with reproductions, severity, and fixes. Re-tested after remediation.

cards.title: AI and agent security.
cards.body: Adversarial testing for language models and agentic systems: prompt injection, tool misuse, policy boundaries, behavioural review.

marquee: built by people who know how it breaks
